rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Security-enhanced fork of the NotebookLM MCP server that enables AI agents to query Google NotebookLM with enterprise-grade protections. Adds 14 security hardening layers including post-quantum encryption (ML-KEM-768 + ChaCha20-Poly1305), secrets scanning for 30+ credential patterns, certificate pinning, memory scrubbing, tamper-evident audit logs, session timeouts, and prompt injection detection. Provides zero-hallucination document analysis with factually-grounded answers from uploaded documents.
